quarterly_data.quarter: Zhongheng Electric half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Product line: HVDC (240V / 336V / 800V), Panama (240V / 400V / 800V), medium / low-voltage distribution, precision distribution and server PSU. Panama converts 10kV directly to DC, compressing a four-stage power chain into one with system efficiency above 97.5%; one Panama system supports 2.5MW of IT load. HVDC is deployed at scale in large cloud data centers, AI computing centers and third-party colo; in 2025 the company built out an 800V DC product line for the AIDC 800V DC ecosystem.
quarterly_data.figure: above 97.5% system efficiency; 2.5MW IT load per Panama system
